name: Piccadilly Pub
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Welcome to the Piccadilly Pub in Tirol

** **

Experience authentic British pub vibes in the heart of Tirol!** The **Piccadilly Pub** in **Innsbruck** is your cozy spot for a taste of home—whether you're craving a classic **Fish & Chips**, a hearty **Sunday Roast**, or a refreshing pint of **Guinness**. Our friendly team serves up traditional British dishes with a touch of Alpine charm, all in a warm, inviting atmosphere.

**

Come by for a drink, a meal, or just good company—we’re always happy to see you!** 🍻

**

Location:

** **

Piccadilly Pub, Innsbruck (right in the city center—easy to find!)

** **

Opening Hours:

** **

Mon–Thu: 12:00–01:00 | Fri–Sat: 12:00–02:00 | Sun: 12:00–23:00

** **

Must-Try:

** **
  • **Full English Breakfast** – Start your day right!
  • **Ploughman’s Lunch** – Cheese, pickles, and crusty bread
  • **Kaiserschmarrn** (yes, we do it British-style too!)
  • **Local Ales & Craft Beers** – From Tirol and beyond
** **

Why Visit?

** **

✔️ Relaxed, homey atmosphere ✔️ Great for groups, couples, or solo adventurers ✔️ Live music & quizzes (check our events!) ✔️ Perfect pre- or post-hike refuel in Tirol

** **

Prost & Cheers!

** **

See you at the **Piccadilly Pub**—where Tirol meets Britain!**

**
